title: Lie Algebras of Locally Finite Derivations over Fields of Positive Characteristic
summary: Let $F$ be a field of positive characteristic, and let $A$ be a finitely generated commutative associative $F$-algebra. We study Lie subalgebras of $Der \, A$ generated by locally finite derivations. We prove that if all commutators of the generators satisfy a natural local finiteness condition, then the associative subalgebra of $End_{F}\, A$ generated by these derivations is finite-dimensional.
